author: themohakagarwal
text:
🚨 Cloud Security Alert

Railway says attackers may have accessed encrypted customer environment variables—and decrypted some secrets.

The platform is urging all users to revoke and rotate API and cloud keys.

Lesson: Treat exposed secrets as compromised and rotate credentials.

author: sudoneeshant
text: VCO admins: check your on-prem version. Arista says CVE-2026-114625 is actively exploited; authenticated users can gain operator privileges. Fixed: 5.2.3.18, 6.1.3.10 or 6.4.2.12. Restrict web access, review logs. Is yours internet-facing? https://t.co/oTuXIcqbnV

author: inaamullah1983
text: Third actively exploited VeloCloud Orchestrator flaw in four months: CVE-2026-114625, SQL injection, CVSS 3.1 9.9. It needs a login, but the lowest tenant role is enough. On-prem: update to 5.2.3.18, 6.1.3.10 or 6.4.2.12. Hosted VCO is already patched.
